columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Permission checks must bind the resource actually used at execution time
columns.title_zh: 权限检查必须绑定执行时真正使用的资源
columns.source_zh: Claude Code 维护者发布的变更记录
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260901-006 after Skill 02 triage. The maintainer change explicitly addresses resource substitution after permission checking and routes browser actions through the same permission path. That creates a bounded Digital Employee authority question: which concrete resource identity and execution route must be bound to a call-time authorization decision so a later TOCTOU substitution cannot inherit stale authority?
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260901-006。维护者变更直接处理权限检查后的资源替换，并让浏览器动作进入同一权限路径。它形成一个边界清晰的数字员工授权问题：调用时授权必须绑定哪些具体资源身份与执行路径，才能防止后续 TOCTOU 替换继承已经过期或不适用的权限？
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the exact permission-check changes, resource-identity binding, TOCTOU window, browser-action mediation path, regression coverage, remaining alternate routes, and whether the evidence supports a general call-time authorization receipt bound to the resource actually executed.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验具体权限检查变更、资源身份绑定、TOCTOU 时间窗、浏览器动作权限路径、回归覆盖、仍存在的替代执行路径，以及这些证据是否足以支持一种绑定实际执行资源的调用时授权回执。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Connector tokens need proof-of-possession identity, not bearer possession
columns.title_zh: 连接器令牌需要持有证明身份，而不能只依赖 Bearer Possession
columns.source_zh: MCP TypeScript SDK 维护者合并提交
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260901-008 after Skill 02 triage. DPoP sender-constrained tokens move connector authorization away from bearer-secret possession by binding token presentation to a client-controlled key. The bounded architecture question is how connector authority should bind principal identity, token material and the presenting runtime so a copied credential cannot be replayed by another worker or host.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260901-008。DPoP Sender-constrained Token 通过把令牌展示绑定到客户端控制的密钥，使连接器授权不再只依赖 Bearer Secret 的持有。这里的架构问题是：连接器权限应如何绑定 Principal Identity、Token Material 与实际展示令牌的 Runtime，才能防止复制出的凭据被其他 Worker 或 Host 重放？
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the DPoP implementation, proof construction and validation, client-key binding, nonce/replay handling, OAuth flow coverage, server-side enforcement points, compatibility limits, and what authority claim is actually strengthened compared with bearer tokens.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 DPoP 实现、Proof 构造与验证、客户端密钥绑定、Nonce/Replay 处理、OAuth Flow 覆盖、服务端强制点、兼容性边界，以及相较 Bearer Token 实际被加强的是哪一类授权主张。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Agent plugin isolation needs a durable recovery transcript outside the failed process
columns.title_zh: Agent Plugin 隔离需要位于故障进程之外的持久恢复 Transcript
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260901-010 after Skill 02 triage. Logos combines peer-process plugin isolation with an append-only transcript used to resume killed sessions without repeating effects. That provides a concrete engineering question spanning two failure boundaries: how much execution state must live outside the failed worker, and what effect identity is required so recovery can replay state without duplicating already-committed external actions?
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260901-010。Logos 将 Plugin 隔离到 Peer Process，并使用 Append-only Transcript 恢复被终止的 Session，同时避免重复副作用。它形成一个跨越两类故障边界的具体工程问题：多少执行状态必须位于故障 Worker 之外，以及恢复时需要怎样的 Effect Identity，才能重建状态而不重复已经提交的外部动作？
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the process-isolation topology, transcript schema and persistence boundary, crash/restart protocol, effect-deduplication semantics, failure experiments, recovery guarantees, unsupported side effects, and whether the evidence establishes bounded recovery rather than universal exactly-once execution.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验进程隔离拓扑、Transcript Schema 与持久边界、Crash/Restart 协议、Effect 去重语义、故障实验、恢复保证、不受支持的副作用，以及证据证明的是有界恢复还是更强的通用 Exactly-once Execution。
